items_flat.title_en: Trump names a Super Intelligence Force led by DNI Jay Clayton
items_flat.title_zh: 川普宣布「超智專案組」，由國家情報總監 Clayton 主持
items_flat.summary_en: No lab announced this. On Oct 4 President Trump posted on Truth Social that a Super Intelligence Force will coordinate federal engagement with consumers, public-interest groups, religious organizations, critical-infrastructure providers and companies, and will protect interests while keeping the US in the lead. BBC, PBS, CNN and TechCrunch name Jay Clayton as lead, with FTC Chair Andrew Ferguson, Pentagon research undersecretary Emil Michael and OPM Director Scott Kupor; the group reports to Trump and chief of staff Susie Wiles. The Wall Street Journal, via TechCrunch, says it has 120 days to report on risks and opportunities.
items_flat.summary_zh: 沒有實驗室宣布此事。川普10月4日在 Truth Social 表示，超智專案組將協調聯邦政府與消費者、公益團體、宗教組織、關鍵基礎設施與相關公司的接觸，並在維持美國領先的同時保護公眾利益。BBC、PBS、CNN 與 TechCrunch 指出，主持者為國家情報總監 Jay Clayton，成員含 FTC 主席 Ferguson、國防部研究次長 Emil Michael 與 OPM 主任 Scott Kupor，並向川普與幕僚長 Susie Wiles 報告。TechCrunch 引述華爾街日報稱，專案組有120天提出風險與機會報告。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is federal coordination and branding, not a lab release or a new statute. Its weight depends on whether the 120-day report and the named officials get a real mandate, or remain a White House messaging vehicle.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是聯邦協調與品牌操作，不是實驗室發布，也不是新法。分量取決於120天報告與具名官員是否拿到實權，或只是白宮訊息載體。
items_flat.quote: The Super Intelligence Force is tasked with coordinating the effort of the Federal Government to ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence.
items_flat.quote_zh: 超智專案組的任務是協調聯邦政府的努力，確保美國繼續在超智領域領先世界。

items_flat.title_en: NYC Council’s Oct 5 AI hearing names lab witnesses; SpaceXAI expected to skip
items_flat.title_zh: 紐約市議會10月5日AI聽證點名證人，SpaceXAI 料不出席
items_flat.summary_en: No lab published testimony in this window. Gothamist, citing Speaker Julie Menin’s office, said Monday’s Committee of the Whole hearing will hear Anthropic Frontier Red Team head Logan Graham, OpenAI policy lead Morgan Dwyer, Meta AI policy director Shane Cahill and Google’s Alice Friend, plus former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, ex-DeepMind researcher Alex Turner and former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo. SpaceXAI answered a subpoena but is likely not sending a representative. Menin’s office is putting 10 bills on the table, including a lead bill that would bar deploying an AI system in the city without third-party validation and a human-operated kill switch.
items_flat.summary_zh: 本時段沒有實驗室公布證詞。Gothamist 引議長 Julie Menin 辦公室稱，週一全院委員會將聽取 Anthropic 前沿紅隊主管 Logan Graham、OpenAI 政策主管 Morgan Dwyer、Meta AI 政策主任 Shane Cahill、Google 的 Alice Friend，以及前 Anthropic 研究員 Jacob Coxon、前 DeepMind 研究員 Alex Turner 與前 OpenAI 研究員 Daniel Kokotajlo。SpaceXAI 已回覆傳票，但很可能不派代表。辦公室提出10項法案，主案要求在市內部署AI系統須經第三方驗證並設人工急停。
items_flat.analysis_en: A city hearing cannot set national model rules, but named company witnesses and a kill-switch bill would put agent-control claims on the record. Whether SpaceXAI’s absence, and what the others say under oath, changes the bills is still open.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 市級聽證定不了全國模型規則，但具名公司證人與急停法案會把代理控制主張寫進紀錄。SpaceXAI 缺席，以及其他人宣誓後說什麼，會不會改法案，仍未定。
items_flat.quote: Whistleblowers are why the world learned of the potential dangers of AI, and they deserve to be protected, rewarded and heard.
items_flat.quote_zh: 吹哨者讓世界得知AI的潛在危險，他們值得被保護、獎勵與傾聽。

items_flat.title_en: Altman says the world should accept some AI harms for the benefits
items_flat.title_zh: Altman 稱世界應接受部分AI傷害以換取利益
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI did not post a new product note in this window. In an Oct 4 interview with Politico’s Decoded, Sam Altman said there is a lot of daylight with Anthropic on regulation, and that the world should accept some bad outcomes so people keep agency and the benefits of deployment. No newer OpenAI post in the last 12 hours changed that account.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 本時段沒有新產品文。Sam Altman 在10月4日接受 Politico Decoded 訪問時說，與 Anthropic 在監管上仍有很大分歧，世界應接受部分不良結果，以保留人的能動性與部署利益。過去12小時沒有更新的 OpenAI 貼文改寫此說法。
items_flat.analysis_en: The interview restates a deployment-first split with Anthropic rather than a new safety commitment. What remains unclear is which harms OpenAI would treat as acceptable in product decisions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這次訪談重申的是與 Anthropic 的部署優先分歧，不是新的安全承諾。OpenAI 會把哪些傷害視為可接受，仍不清楚。
items_flat.quote: we believe that the world should accept some bad things happening for the benefits of this technology and people having the agency.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們認為，世界應接受一些壞事發生，以換取這項技術的效益，並讓人們保有能動性。

items_flat.title_en: Google pauses open-source bug-bounty product reports over automated submissions
items_flat.title_zh: Google 因自動提交激增，暫停開源漏洞賞金的產品回報
items_flat.summary_en: Google’s bug-hunting account said it is temporarily no longer accepting product vulnerability submissions to the Open Source Software Vulnerability Rewards Program, effective Oct 1, while supply-chain reports and outstanding reports continue. TechCrunch and The Verge quote the company blaming a significant rise in automated submissions, the vast majority of which are not valid, with an update promised in the first quarter of 2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google 漏洞獵人帳號表示，自10月1日起暫不接受開源軟體漏洞獎勵計畫的產品漏洞提交，供應鏈回報與未結案報告仍繼續。TechCrunch 與 The Verge 引述公司說法，原因是自動提交顯著增加，絕大多數無效，並承諾2027年第一季更新。
items_flat.analysis_en: The pause is a concrete cost of agent-written security reports, not a model launch. It does not show that valid AI-assisted research is being banned, only that Google’s reviewers cannot absorb the volume.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是代理撰寫安全報告的具體成本，不是模型發布。它沒有證明合法的AI輔助研究被禁，只說明審查量已超出負荷。
items_flat.quote: This pause is due to a significant rise in automated submissions, the vast majority of which are not valid.
items_flat.quote_zh: 此次暫停是因為自動提交顯著增加，其中絕大多數並非有效。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic asks Claude users to opt in to voice-data training
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 請 Claude 使用者選擇是否用語音資料訓練
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic did not post a newsroom note in this window. BleepingComputer reported on Oct 4, and gHacks on Oct 5, that Claude’s voice features now ask users to allow audio recordings and voice chats to improve models, with an Allow or Not now choice and a separate privacy toggle from text-chat training. In the interfaces described, the setting is off by default.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 本時段沒有新聞室稿。BleepingComputer 於10月4日、gHacks 於10月5日報道，Claude 語音功能現在詢問使用者是否允許錄音與語音對話用於改進模型，可選允許或暫時不要，且與文字對話訓練分開。所描述的介面中，該設定預設關閉。
items_flat.analysis_en: The change matters if Anthropic now retains voice audio it previously discarded after transcription. It is opt-in in the reported interface, but retention periods and training use are still not in an official post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 若 Anthropic 現在保留以往轉寫後即丟棄的語音，這就有實質影響。報道中的介面是選擇加入，但保留期限與訓練用途仍沒有官方貼文說明。
items_flat.quote: Allow us to use your voice data to improve our AI models.
items_flat.quote_zh: 允許我們使用你的語音資料來改進我們的AI模型。

items_flat.title_en: Musk says SpaceXAI will be renamed SpaceXSI
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克說 SpaceXAI 將改名 SpaceXSI
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI did not publish a rebrand page. On Oct 4 Elon Musk posted “No more AI / SI / It’s better,” called SpaceX a super intelligence company, and replied “Yes, we will make that change” when asked if SpaceXAI would become SpaceXSI. No domain, account or product rename appeared in the last 12 hours; his later posts amplified Grok Imagine clips and a Grok Bot hiring guide.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 沒有發布改名頁。馬斯克10月4日貼出「不再用AI／改用SI／這樣更好」，稱 SpaceX 是超智公司，並在被問到是否改名 SpaceXSI 時回覆「是，我們會做這個改變」。過去12小時未見網域、帳號或產品改名；他後來的貼文是轉發 Grok Imagine 與 Grok Bot 指南。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is an executive branding commitment tied to the White House’s super-intelligence wording, not a shipped product or model. Until domains, accounts and contracts change, SpaceXAI remains the operating name.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是配合白宮超智用語的高層品牌承諾，不是已出貨的產品或模型。在網域、帳號與合約改完之前，SpaceXAI 仍是運作名稱。
items_flat.quote: Yes, we will make that change

items_flat.title_en: Musk says Grok 4.7 is number one on the AA Cyber Index
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱 Grok 4.7 在 AA 資安指數排名第一
items_flat.summary_en: xAI did not announce a new model. On Oct 4 Musk quote-posted a claim that Grok 4.7 xHigh ranked first on Artificial Analysis’ Cyber Index and wrote “Grok 4.7 is #1 on the AA Cyber Index.” The underlying board was not a new xAI release in this window.
items_flat.summary_zh: xAI 沒有宣布新模型。馬斯克10月4日轉引一則說法，稱 Grok 4.7 xHigh 在 Artificial Analysis 資安指數排名第一，並寫下「Grok 4.7 在 AA 資安指數第一」。該榜單在本時段不是 xAI 的新發布。
items_flat.analysis_en: The post is an executive amplification of a third-party board, not a release. A single composite rank does not by itself show Grok ahead of Opus 5.5 or Astra on every cyber subscore.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是高層放大第三方榜單，不是發布。單一綜合排名本身不能證明 Grok 在每個資安子項都領先 Opus 5.5 或 Astra。
items_flat.quote: Grok 4.7 is #1 on the AA Cyber Index
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok 4.7 在 AA 資安指數排名第一。

items_flat.title_en: Musk highlights Farmersville’s plan to draft council minutes with Grok
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克轉發 Farmersville 用 Grok 起草市議會紀錄
items_flat.summary_en: SpaceXAI and xAI did not announce a government product. On Oct 4 Musk quote-posted a report that Farmersville, California, voted 4-1 on Sept 29 to have Grok draft verbatim council minutes from recordings, with the city clerk proofreading them. No further official update appeared in the last 12 hours.
items_flat.summary_zh: SpaceXAI 與 xAI 沒有宣布政府產品。馬斯克10月4日轉發一則報道，稱加州 Farmersville 於9月29日以4比1通過，由 Grok 依錄音起草逐字市議會紀錄，再由市書記校對。過去12小時沒有進一步官方更新。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a small civic workflow trial, not a lab shipment. A human clerk remains in the loop, so accuracy and public-record liability stay local.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是小型市政流程試驗，不是實驗室出貨。人工書記仍在迴路中，準確性與公文書責任仍在地方。

frontier_other.summary_en: No lab published testimony in this window. Gothamist, citing Speaker Julie Menin’s office, said Monday’s Committee of the Whole hearing will hear Anthropic Frontier Red Team head Logan Graham, OpenAI policy lead Morgan Dwyer, Meta AI policy director Shane Cahill and Google’s Alice Friend, plus former Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon, ex-DeepMind researcher Alex Turner and former OpenAI researcher Daniel Kokotajlo. SpaceXAI answered a subpoena but is likely not sending a representative. Menin’s office is putting 10 bills on the table, including a lead bill that would bar deploying an AI system in the city without third-party validation and a human-operated kill switch.
frontier_other.summary_zh: 本時段沒有實驗室公布證詞。Gothamist 引議長 Julie Menin 辦公室稱，週一全院委員會將聽取 Anthropic 前沿紅隊主管 Logan Graham、OpenAI 政策主管 Morgan Dwyer、Meta AI 政策主任 Shane Cahill、Google 的 Alice Friend，以及前 Anthropic 研究員 Jacob Coxon、前 DeepMind 研究員 Alex Turner 與前 OpenAI 研究員 Daniel Kokotajlo。SpaceXAI 已回覆傳票，但很可能不派代表。辦公室提出10項法案，主案要求在市內部署AI系統須經第三方驗證並設人工急停。
frontier_other.analysis_en: A city hearing cannot set national model rules, but named company witnesses and a kill-switch bill would put agent-control claims on the record. Whether SpaceXAI’s absence, and what the others say under oath, changes the bills is still open.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 市級聽證定不了全國模型規則，但具名公司證人與急停法案會把代理控制主張寫進紀錄。SpaceXAI 缺席，以及其他人宣誓後說什麼，會不會改法案，仍未定。
frontier_other.quote: Whistleblowers are why the world learned of the potential dangers of AI, and they deserve to be protected, rewarded and heard.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 吹哨者讓世界得知AI的潛在危險，他們值得被保護、獎勵與傾聽。

brief_en: No lab shipped a model in the last 12 hours. Trump’s Super Intelligence Force is now named, led by DNI Jay Clayton, with a reported 120-day brief. NYC’s Oct 5 hearing has named lab witnesses; SpaceXAI is expected to skip. Google’s OSS bug bounty stays paused over automated reports.
brief_zh: 過去12小時無新模型。川普點名Clayton領超智專案組。紐約聽證證人已定，SpaceXAI料缺席。Google開源漏洞賞金因自動回報暫停。
